title: Spotlight
text: Dims the page around the target with a CSS cut-out that follows scrolling and resizing, under a strict CSP.

title: A dialog per step
text: Non-modal by default, modal on request; focus moves into every step and returns when the tour ends.

title: Keyboard first
text: Next, Back, Skip, and Finish buttons, arrow keys mirrored in RTL, and Escape to skip.

title: Robust targets
text: Elements, selectors, or functions; missing targets are skipped with an event, and hooks can open what a step needs.

title: Progress
text: "2 of 5" announced with each step, optional dots, and targets scrolled into view.
